blogs.title: Why?
blogs.subtitle: An ardor for lonliness and solitude
paragraphs:
Why do I find peace in the quiet of my room,
Why does the hum of silence feel like a gentle boom?
Why do crowded spaces feel heavy and loud,
Why do I hide my voice beneath the chatter of a crowd?

Why does a book speak louder than a room full of talk,
Why do I feel free when I take a solo walk?
Why does the world slow down when I'm alone,
Why does my mind find comfort in thoughts I own?

Why do deep conversations mean more than small words,
Why does my heart take flight when unseen like birds?
Why do I see beauty in moments others pass by,
Why do I feel calm under a vast, endless sky?

Why do I hesitate to say what I truly feel,
Why do I retreat when life spins its wheel?
Why is solitude a sanctuary, not a cage,
Why do I feel older than my own age?

Why, you may ask, do I choose this gentle retreat?
Why, I'll reply, it's where I feel most complete.
